description: JavaScript demo code for generating QR codes, including functions for rendering QR codes on canvas or SVG, handling user input, and displaying QR code statistics.

methods.name: redrawQrCode
methods.description: Main function to generate and display QR code based on user input, handling both bitmap and SVG outputs, and updating statistics.

methods.name: getInputErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Determines the error correction level for QR code based on selected radio buttons.

methods.name: describeSegments
methods.description: Provides a string description of QR code segments' encoding mode.

methods.name: countUnicodeChars
methods.description: Counts Unicode code points in a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: handleVersionMinMax
methods.description: Adjusts minimum and maximum QR code version constraints and triggers QR code redraw.
